    public function arrayForget(&$array, $keys)

        $this->arrayWorkspace = func_get_args();
        $this->arrayWorkspaceOp = 'forget';
        $original = &$array;

        $keys = (array) $keys;

        if (count($keys) === 0) {

        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            // if the exact key exists in the top-level, remove it
            if ($this->arrayExists($array, $key)) {
                unset($array[$key]);

                continue;
            }

            $parts = explode('.', $key);

            // clean up before each pass
            $array = &$original;

            while (count($parts) > 1) {
                $part = array_shift($parts);

                if (isset($array[$part]) && $this->arrayAccessible($array[$part])) {
                    $array = &$array[$part];
                } else {
                    continue 2;
                }

            unset($array[array_shift($parts)]);

    public function arrayGet($array, $key, $default = null)

        if ($this->arrayExists($array, $key)) {
            return $array[$key];
        }

        if (! str_contains($key, '.')) {
            return $array[$key] ?? value($default);

        foreach (explode('.', $key) as $segment) {
            if ($this->arrayAccessible($array) && $this->arrayExists($array, $segment)) {
                $array = $array[$segment];
            } else {
                return value($default);
            }
        }

        return $array;

            foreach (explode('.', $key) as $segment) {
                if ($this->arrayAccessible($subKeyArray) && $this->arrayExists($subKeyArray, $segment)) {
                    $subKeyArray = $subKeyArray[$segment];

        return true;

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `enum_value()` (src/Illuminate/Support/functions.php): it used `transform()`, which returns the `$default` (null) for "blank" values like empty collections, and `Js::convertDataToJavaScriptExpression()` called it on every input. Changes mirror upstream fix #53206:

- **src/Illuminate/Support/Js.php:401** — only call `enum_value()` when `$data instanceof UnitEnum`
- **src/Illuminate/Support/functions.php** — removed the `empty($value)` guard and changed the fallback to `$default ?? $value` so non-enum values (including empty collections) pass through unchanged

Verified: `Js::from([])`, `Js::from(new Collection)`, and `Js::from(collect())` now return `[]`, `Js::from(null)` still returns `null`. `SupportJsTest` + `SupportEnumValueFunctionTest` pass (22/22); full `tests/Support` run has no failures (remaining 8 errors are pre-existing baseline issues: missing `intl` extension and a testbench queue-command mismatch, confirmed identical before the fix except the 2 failures my change resolved).
